This block is written for someone about 1 months past their injury, at the rebuild stage of the return, and it progresses on what the tissue tolerates rather than on the calendar. Nine months postpartum and cleared means we can train this as a rebuild block, not a rehab block. You have 3 low-cost full-body gym sessions on Mon-Tue-Wed and 3 direct running exposures each week: a very easy Monday tissue-tolerance run, Thursday goal-pace touches, and Saturday run-walk work that steadily reduces the walking so you are running longer chunks again. Broken sleep is the governor, so every increase is earned by a clean prior week.

Weeks 2-3 progress the running only: Thursday reps get longer at the same 10 km pace touch, and Saturday keeps the total block about the same while lengthening the run segments. The gym work mostly holds on purpose so recovery goes to the 10 km. Week 4 keeps the best Week 3 standards but trims gym and run volume so you finish fresher, not flatter.

If you feel heaviness, leaking, pain, or a clear pressure change, stop that row, walk, and repeat the last clean week next time. On a bad sleep day, drop the last accessory first; if squats or lunges feel too pressurizing that day, swap that lower-body row to Prowler focus for the same set count and keep it smooth.

START_WEEK1_TSV
Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results
Mon	[WARMUP] Bodyweight Squat	Bodyweight	1	8	N/A	2	2 min brisk walk, 8 squats, then 2 ramp sets for Goblet Squat.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12	
Mon	Goblet Squat	16 kg	3	8	90 sec	6-7	Known anchor load from your current 16 kg x 10. If pressure, technique drift, or RPE goes past 7, stop at 2 sets and repeat this week next time.	
Mon	Barbell Hip Thrust	RPE-selected load	3	8	90 sec	6-7	Choose a load that leaves about 3 reps in reserve; if setup or sleep makes it feel heavy, hold the load and keep all reps crisp.	
Mon	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	2	10	75 sec	7	Upper-body maintenance. Smooth pulls, no grinding.	
Mon	Pallof Press	RPE-selected load	2	10/side	45 sec	6	Exhale through the press and brace without bearing down.	
Mon	Run	Easy 6:30-7:00/km on run segments	1	8 min	N/A	3-4	Low-cost third run. Easy continuous if it feels totally normal; otherwise use 2 min run and 1 min walk inside the 8 min.	
Tue	[WARMUP] Run	Easy walk-jog	1	5 min	N/A	2-3	Easy treadmill walk-jog, then 1 light ramp set for Reverse Lunge.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8	
Tue	Reverse Lunge	RPE-selected load	2	8/side	90 sec	6-7	Use dumbbells only if balance and pressure stay clean; if not, bodyweight is fine this week.	
Tue	Dumbbell Bench Press	RPE-selected load	3	8	75 sec	7	Maintenance pressing. Stop 2 reps before any grind.	
Tue	Seated Cable Row	RPE-selected load	2	10	60 sec	7	Squeeze, pause, and keep the chest tall.	
Tue	Seated Calf Raise	RPE-selected load	2	12	45 sec	7	Running tissue-capacity work. Full stretch and controlled pause.	
Wed	[WARMUP] Run	Easy walk-jog	1	5 min	N/A	2-3	Easy treadmill walk-jog, then get straight to the sled.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8	
Wed	Push-up	Bodyweight	3	8	60 sec	7	Leave 2-3 reps in reserve; clean trunk position every rep.	
Wed	Seated Cable Row	RPE-selected load	2	10	60 sec	7	Upper-back maintenance. Keep it smooth, not maximal.	
Wed	Prowler Push	RPE-selected load	6	15 m	60-75 sec	6-7	Recovery-contingent lower-body work. Strong walk, no grind; if Thursday run quality feels at risk, stop at 4 pushes.	
Wed	Farmer Carry	RPE-selected load	3	20 m	60 sec	6	Walk tall and breathe behind the brace. First row to skip if time or sleep is wrecked.	
Thu	[WARMUP] Run	Easy walk-jog	1	8 min	N/A	2-3	Build from walk to easy jog, then start the first rep controlled.	
Thu	Run	5:18-5:12/km	6	1 min	2 min walk	7	Goal-pace touch. Smooth, not a test; if you cannot hold the pace without straining, slow slightly and repeat this structure next week.	
Sat	[WARMUP] Run	Easy walk-jog	1	6 min	N/A	2-3	Start very easy and let breathing settle before the main set.	
Sat	Run	Easy 6:25-6:55/km on run segments	1	24 min	N/A	4	8 rounds of 2 min run and 1 min walk. Conversational throughout; if this feels harder than easy, keep the same pattern next week.	
END_WEEK1_TSV

START_WEEK3_TSV
Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results

Mon	Goblet Squat	16 kg	3	8	90 sec	6-7	Known anchor load from your current 16 kg x 10. If pressure, technique drift, or RPE goes past 7, stop at 2 sets and repeat this week next time.	
Mon	Barbell Hip Thrust	RPE-selected load	3	8	90 sec	6-7	Choose a load that leaves about 3 reps in reserve; if setup or sleep makes it feel heavy, hold the load and keep all reps crisp.	
Mon	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	1	10	75 sec	7	Upper-body maintenance. Smooth pulls, no grinding. Trimmed as the block shifts toward the sport: general work gives way as tolerance for the event improves.	
Mon	Pallof Press	RPE-selected load	1	10/side	45 sec	6	Exhale through the press and brace without bearing down. Trimmed as the block shifts toward the sport: general work gives way as tolerance for the event improves.

Tue	Reverse Lunge	RPE-selected load	2	8/side	90 sec	6-7	Use dumbbells only if balance and pressure stay clean; if not, bodyweight is fine this week.	
Tue	Dumbbell Bench Press	RPE-selected load	1	8	75 sec	7	Maintenance pressing. Stop 2 reps before any grind. Trimmed as the block shifts toward the sport: general work gives way as tolerance for the event improves.	
Tue	Seated Cable Row	RPE-selected load	1	10	60 sec	7	Squeeze, pause, and keep the chest tall. Trimmed as the block shifts toward the sport: general work gives way as tolerance for the event improves.	
Tue	Run	Easy, conversational	1	15 min	n/a	4	Replaces Seated Calf Raise: an extra low-cost exposure to the sport, easy throughout and well inside what is tolerated. The return is measured in how much of the week is spent on the sport, not in how much the gym work has progressed.	
Wed	[WARMUP] Run	Easy walk-jog	1	5 min	N/A	2-3	Easy treadmill walk-jog, then get straight to the sled.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8	
Wed	Push-up	Bodyweight	3	8	60 sec	7	Leave 2-3 reps in reserve; clean trunk position every rep.	
Wed	Seated Cable Row	RPE-selected load	1	10	60 sec	7	Upper-back maintenance. Keep it smooth, not maximal. Trimmed as the block shifts toward the sport: general work gives way as tolerance for the event improves.	
Wed	Prowler Push	RPE-selected load	6	15 m	60-75 sec	6-7	Recovery-contingent lower-body work. Strong walk, no grind; if Thursday run quality feels at risk, stop at 4 pushes.	
Wed	Farmer Carry	RPE-selected load	3	20 m	60 sec	6	Walk tall and breathe behind the brace. First row to skip if time or sleep is wrecked.	
Thu	[WARMUP] Run	Easy walk-jog	1	8 min	N/A	2-3	Build from walk to easy jog, then start the first rep controlled.	
Thu	Run	5:18-5:12/km	4	2 min	2 min walk	7-7.5	Progression is rep length only. If Week 2 pace felt strained or impact response was not clean, repeat Week 2.	
Sat	[WARMUP] Run	Easy walk-jog	1	6 min	N/A	2-3	Start very easy and let breathing settle before the main set.	
Sat	Run	Easy 6:25-6:55/km on run segments	1	24 min	N/A	5	4 rounds of 5 min run and 1 min walk. This is the longest sustained running of the block; only take it if Week 2 felt clean.

START_WEEK4_TSV
Day	Exercise	Weight	Sets	Reps	Rest	Target RPE	Notes	Results
Mon	[WARMUP] Bodyweight Squat	Bodyweight	1	8	N/A	2	2 min brisk walk, 8 squats, then 2 ramp sets for Goblet Squat.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12	
Mon	Goblet Squat	16 kg	2	8	90 sec	6-7	Consolidation week: keep the same clean load, but leave one set in the bank.	
Mon	Barbell Hip Thrust	RPE-selected load	2	8	90 sec	6-7	Consolidation week: same effort cap, fewer total sets.	
Mon	Chest-Supported Row	RPE-selected load	1	10	75 sec	7	Keep this smooth and stop well before any grind. Trimmed as the block shifts toward the sport: general work gives way as tolerance for the event improves.	
Mon	Pallof Press	RPE-selected load	1	10/side	45 sec	6	One clean set only this week.	
Mon	Run	Easy 6:30-7:00/km on run segments	1	8 min	N/A	3-4	Low-cost third run. Easy continuous if it feels totally normal; otherwise use 2 min run and 1 min walk inside the 8 min.	
Tue	[WARMUP] Run	Easy walk-jog	1	5 min	N/A	2-3	Easy treadmill walk-jog, then 1 light ramp set for Reverse Lunge.; Squat-and-reach x 6; Bodyweight squat x 8; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8	
Tue	Reverse Lunge	RPE-selected load	2	8/side	90 sec	6-7	Hold the same quality as Week 3; no extra push this week.	
Tue	Dumbbell Bench Press	RPE-selected load	1	8	75 sec	7	Consolidation week: same quality, stop 2 reps before any grind. Trimmed as the block shifts toward the sport: general work gives way as tolerance for the event improves.	
Tue	Seated Cable Row	RPE-selected load	1	10	60 sec	7	One clean maintenance set.	
Tue	Run	Easy, conversational	1	20 min	n/a	4	Replaces Seated Calf Raise: an extra low-cost exposure to the sport, easy throughout and well inside what is tolerated. The return is measured in how much of the week is spent on the sport, not in how much the gym work has progressed.	
Wed	[WARMUP] Run	Easy walk-jog	1	5 min	N/A	2-3	Easy treadmill walk-jog, then get straight to the sled.; Scapular pull-up 2 x 5-6; Band pull-apart x 10-12; Band shoulder pass-through x 10; Scapular push-up x 8	
Wed	Push-up	Bodyweight	2	8	60 sec	7	Leave 2-3 reps in reserve and keep every rep crisp.	
Wed	Seated Cable Row	RPE-selected load	1	10	60 sec	7	One smooth maintenance set.	
Wed	Prowler Push	RPE-selected load	4	15 m	60-75 sec	6	Consolidation week: same smooth standard, fewer pushes.	
Wed	Farmer Carry	RPE-selected load	2	20 m	60 sec	6	Walk tall. If sleep is especially bad, this is still the first row to remove.	
Thu	[WARMUP] Run	Easy walk-jog	1	8 min	N/A	2-3	Build from walk to easy jog, then start the first rep controlled.	
Thu	Run	5:18-5:12/km	3	2 min	2 min walk	7	Keep the best Week 3 pace standard, but cut the volume and finish feeling sharp.	
Sat	[WARMUP] Run	Easy walk-jog	1	6 min	N/A	2-3	Start very easy and let breathing settle before the main set.	
Sat	Run	Easy 6:25-6:55/km on run segments	1	18 min	N/A	4-5	3 rounds of 5 min run and 1 min walk. Match Week 3 smoothness, then stop early on purpose so you finish the block fresher.	
END_WEEK4_TSV
